text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Pushing herself with relentless enthusiasm 
as always, Hishi Miracle finally ends up 
overworked.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I thought the driving force behind her 
motivation was something positive, but the 
truth behind it was actuallyâ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It was the fear that if she gave it her 
all and proved lacking, she might be 
abandoned.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Told by their Trainer that it was okay to 
fail, and that they would win together and 
lose together, she finally regained her 
natural, unburdened self.
